guide.title: User guide
guide.summary: This page will gradually document UniKorn's core features so new users can get started quickly.
guide.sectionOneBody: Browse the forum, search course reviews, join activities, form teams, and manage your campus identity and profile.
guide.sectionTwoBody: Chinese remains the default language, while English pages are available under the /en prefix. New pages will follow the same approach.

rules.title: Community rules
rules.summary: Please follow these basic rules to keep the community welcoming and useful.
rules.sectionOneBody: Do not post harassment, discrimination, personal attacks, privacy violations, or intentionally inflammatory content.
rules.sectionTwoBody: Course reviews, team-matching posts, and requests for help should be as truthful and clear as possible to avoid misleading others.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.summary: UniKorn tries to collect only the data needed to run the platform and respects your visibility settings.
privacy.sectionOneBody: Account details, avatars, posts, comments, notifications, and required identity-verification data are used to provide platform features.
privacy.sectionTwoBody: You can manage your public profile, contact details, and some notification settings. A fuller privacy policy can be added later.

academicMap.title: Academic Map
academicMap.subtitle: Turn completed courses, in-progress or planned courses, target majors, and optional private grades into a clear academic state map for future personalized planning.

login.title: Log in to maintain your Academic Map
login.copy: This information belongs to you. Course records and grades are not public, and they will help future planning suggestions become more precise.

targetMajors.title: Target majors
targetMajors.copy: You can adjust the majors you are considering at any time so the future planning system understands how your direction changes.
targetMajors.label: Majors to compare
targetMajors.limit: Keep up to 3 directions at once. You can change them anytime.

import.title: Import Course History
import.copy: Paste the copied text from your school course history, preview the parsed rows, then save them to your private Academic Map.
import.placeholder: Paste something like: AIAA 2205 Introduction to AI 2024-25 Summer A+ 3.00
import.keepGradesCopy: Grades are visible only to you and can be deleted anytime. Keeping them helps future planning reason about difficulty, strengths, and gaps.

privacy.title: Grade privacy
privacy.copy: Grades are never shown publicly. You can keep them for future recommendations or delete them now or later.
